column25: NOTE: Images is REQUIRED for every parent product row (Type=variable or simple). Put the image filename(s) already uploaded to the Media Library here, comma-separated, e.g. body-wave-01.webp,body-wave-02.webp. A blank Images cell imports the product with NO photo and the storefront then shows a grey placeholder. Variation rows may stay blank; they inherit the parent image (or give a variation its own filename for a per-variation photo). This helper column is not a WooCommerce field: choose Do not import for it (or delete the column) when running the importer.
